title: Ugly Love
author: Colleen Hoover
summary: Tate, a nurse trainee, and Miles, a pilot who's closed off to love, agree to a purely physical arrangement with strict rules. Chapters from his past explain why he can't let anyone in.
readIf: you want an angsty, steamy romance with a wounded hero and a heartbreaking backstory.
skipIf: you dislike emotionally unavailable heroes or a hot-and-cold relationship.

pairings.reason: Another Hoover novel where grief and a past mistake stand between two people.
A sportier, lighter college romance that begins as an arrangement and turns real.
Another Hoover romance with a time-spanning structure and an emotional reveal.
